summary: Provides the framework for dynamic provisioning of MPLS-TP transport paths using a control plane, covering addressing, routing, path computation, signaling, traffic engineering, and recovery. MPLS-TP uses GMPLS as its control plane. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Paths can be set up by hand or by automatic software. This explains how the automatic version works for MPLS-TP networks, using the GMPLS tool set.
